name.S: Cohort 1 - Week 1: Cloud Fundamentals & AWS Basics

description.S: Introduction to cloud computing concepts, AWS platform overview, and account setup.
Cloud networking, VPC setup, subnets, routing, and network security.
EC2 instances, auto-scaling, Lambda functions, and serverless architecture.
S3 buckets, EBS volumes, RDS databases, and data persistence strategies.
IAM policies, roles, and security best practices in AWS.

description.S: CloudWatch, logging, CloudFormation, and IaC practices.
Security architecture, encryption, compliance standards, and risk management.
